```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Read OncoKB cancer-gene list
# -------------------------------

cancer_dt <- fread(
  cancer_gene_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE
)

possible_hugo_cols <- c(
  "Hugo Symbol",
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "HugoSymbol",
  "Gene",
  "SYMBOL"
)

hugo_col <- possible_hugo_cols[
  possible_hugo_cols %in% names(cancer_dt)
]

if (!length(hugo_col)) {
  stop(
    "No recognized gene-symbol column found in cancerGeneList.tsv. ",
    "Available columns: ",
    paste(names(cancer_dt), collapse = ", ")
  )
}

if (length(hugo_col) > 1L) {
  message(
    "Multiple candidate symbol columns found; using: ",
    hugo_col[1]
  )
}

cancer_genes <- unique(
  toupper(trimws(as.character(cancer_dt[[hugo_col[1]]])))
)
cancer_genes <- cancer_genes[
  !is.na(cancer_genes) &
    cancer_genes != ""
]

message("OncoKB cancer genes loaded: ", length(cancer_genes))
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Helper functions
# -------------------------------

clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- sub("(_T|-T|\\.T)$", "", x)
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

clean_gene <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x[x %in% c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

to_numeric <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(gsub("%", "", trimws(as.character(x))))
  )
}

# Produce a consistent genomic-allele key.
# MAF insertions represented with REF="-" use the left-flank coordinate;
# therefore the inserted sequence begins at Start_Position + 1.
edit_key <- function(chr, pos, ref, alt, maf_format = FALSE) {
  chr <- sub("^CHR", "", toupper(trimws(as.character(chr))))
  pos <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(pos))
  ref <- toupper(trimws(as.character(ref)))
  alt <- toupper(trimws(as.character(alt)))

  if (anyNA(c(chr, pos, ref, alt)) ||
      !nzchar(chr) || pos < 1L ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", ref) ||
      !grepl("^([ACGTN]+|-)$", alt)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  if (maf_format && ref == "-") {
    pos <- pos + 1L
  }

  if (ref == "-") ref <- ""
  if (alt == "-") alt <- ""

  # Remove identical suffixes.
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, nchar(ref), nchar(ref)) ==
           substr(alt, nchar(alt), nchar(alt))) {
    ref <- substr(ref, 1, nchar(ref) - 1L)
    alt <- substr(alt, 1, nchar(alt) - 1L)
  }

  # Remove identical prefixes and shift the position.
  while (nzchar(ref) && nzchar(alt) &&
         substr(ref, 1, 1) == substr(alt, 1, 1)) {
    ref <- substring(ref, 2)
    alt <- substring(alt, 2)
    pos <- pos + 1L
  }

  if (!nzchar(ref) && !nzchar(alt)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(
    chr,
    pos,
    ifelse(nzchar(ref), ref, "-"),
    ifelse(nzchar(alt), alt, "-"),
    sep = ":"
  )
}

# Parse PCGR GENOMIC_CHANGE values such as 16:g.68801891C>T.
pcgr_genomic_key <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))

  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  pattern <- paste0(
    "^(?:chr)?([^:]+):g\\.([0-9]+)",
    "([ACGTN]+|-)>([ACGTN]+|-)$"
  )

  hit <- regmatches(
    x,
    regexec(pattern, x, perl = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  )[[1]]

  if (length(hit) == 5L) {
    return(edit_key(hit[2], hit[3], hit[4], hit[5]))
  }

  NA_character_
}
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Read Tier 1 common MAF
# -------------------------------

maf_dt <- fread(
  maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  data.table = TRUE,
  na.strings = c("", ".", "NA", "N/A")
)

required_cols <- c(
  "Hugo_Symbol",
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Variant_Classification",
  "Chromosome",
  "Start_Position",
  "Reference_Allele",
  "Tumor_Seq_Allele2"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(maf_dt))

if (length(missing_cols)) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns in MAF: ",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

maf_dt[, Hugo_Symbol_clean := clean_gene(Hugo_Symbol)]
maf_dt[, Sample_key := clean_sample(Tumor_Sample_Barcode)]
maf_dt[, Variant_key := mapply(
  edit_key,
  Chromosome,
  Start_Position,
  Reference_Allele,
  Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
  MoreArgs = list(maf_format = TRUE),
  USE.NAMES = FALSE
)]
maf_dt[, Match_key := paste(
  Sample_key,
  Hugo_Symbol_clean,
  Variant_key,
  sep = "|"
)]

if (anyNA(maf_dt$Sample_key) ||
    anyNA(maf_dt$Hugo_Symbol_clean) ||
    anyNA(maf_dt$Variant_key)) {
  stop("Some MAF rows could not be normalized for PCGR matching.")
}
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Read VAF_TUMOR from all With-PoN PCGR workbooks
# -------------------------------

pcgr_files <- list.files(
  pcgr_dir,
  pattern = "\\.pcgr\\.grch38\\.xlsx$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (!length(pcgr_files)) {
  stop("No PCGR workbooks found under: ", pcgr_dir)
}

pcgr_list <- vector("list", length(pcgr_files))
file_audit <- vector("list", length(pcgr_files))

for (i in seq_along(pcgr_files)) {
  file_path <- pcgr_files[i]
  sample_folder <- basename(dirname(file_path))

  sheets <- tryCatch(
    excel_sheets(file_path),
    error = function(e) character()
  )

  if (!"SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL" %in% sheets) {
    file_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      SAMPLE_FOLDER = sample_folder,
      STATUS = "missing_sheet",
      PCGR_FILE = file_path
    )
    next
  }

  dt <- tryCatch(
    as.data.table(
      read_excel(
        file_path,
        sheet = "SOMATIC_SNV_INDEL",
        guess_max = 100000
      )
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  required_pcgr <- c("SYMBOL", "GENOMIC_CHANGE", "VAF_TUMOR")

  if (is.null(dt)) {
    file_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      SAMPLE_FOLDER = sample_folder,
      STATUS = "read_error",
      PCGR_FILE = file_path
    )
    next
  }

  missing_pcgr <- setdiff(required_pcgr, names(dt))

  if (length(missing_pcgr)) {
    file_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
      SAMPLE_FOLDER = sample_folder,
      STATUS = paste0(
        "missing_columns:",
        paste(missing_pcgr, collapse = ",")
      ),
      PCGR_FILE = file_path
    )
    next
  }

  tmp <- dt[
    ,
    .(
      Sample_key = clean_sample(sample_folder),
      Hugo_Symbol_clean = clean_gene(SYMBOL),
      Variant_key = vapply(
        GENOMIC_CHANGE,
        pcgr_genomic_key,
        character(1)
      ),
      VAF_TUMOR_raw = to_numeric(VAF_TUMOR),
      GENOMIC_CHANGE = as.character(GENOMIC_CHANGE),
      PCGR_FILE = file_path
    )
  ]

  numeric_vaf <- tmp$VAF_TUMOR_raw[!is.na(tmp$VAF_TUMOR_raw)]

  if (length(numeric_vaf) && max(numeric_vaf) > 1) {
    if (max(numeric_vaf) <= 100) {
      tmp[, VAF_TUMOR_fraction := VAF_TUMOR_raw / 100]
      scale_type <- "percent"
    } else {
      scale_type <- "invalid"
      tmp[, VAF_TUMOR_fraction := NA_real_]
    }
  } else {
    tmp[, VAF_TUMOR_fraction := VAF_TUMOR_raw]
    scale_type <- if (length(numeric_vaf)) "fraction" else "no_numeric_VAF"
  }

  tmp[, Match_key := paste(
    Sample_key,
    Hugo_Symbol_clean,
    Variant_key,
    sep = "|"
  )]

  pcgr_list[[i]] <- tmp
  file_audit[[i]] <- data.table(
    SAMPLE_FOLDER = sample_folder,
    STATUS = "ok",
    VAF_SCALE = scale_type,
    VARIANT_ROWS = nrow(tmp),
    NUMERIC_VAF_ROWS = sum(!is.na(tmp$VAF_TUMOR_fraction)),
    PCGR_FILE = file_path
  )
}

pcgr_dt <- rbindlist(pcgr_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
pcgr_file_audit <- rbindlist(file_audit, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

fwrite(
  pcgr_file_audit,
  file.path(
    out_dir,
    paste0("PCGR_VAF_file_audit_", run_date, ".tsv")
  ),
  sep = "\t",
  na = "NA"
)

if (!nrow(pcgr_dt)) {
  stop("No PCGR VAF records were extracted. Review PCGR_VAF_file_audit.")
}

if (any(
  !is.na(pcgr_dt$VAF_TUMOR_fraction) &
    (pcgr_dt$VAF_TUMOR_fraction < 0 |
       pcgr_dt$VAF_TUMOR_fraction > 1)
)) {
  stop("PCGR VAF_TUMOR values outside the valid 0–1 range were detected.")
}

# Collapse duplicate PCGR rows for the same exact sample-gene-variant key.
pcgr_vaf <- pcgr_dt[
  !is.na(Variant_key),
  .(
    VAF_TUMOR_fraction = if (all(is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      median(VAF_TUMOR_fraction, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    PCGR_rows = .N
  ),
  by = Match_key
]
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Add PCGR VAF to the MAF by exact sample-gene-variant match
# -------------------------------

maf_vaf <- merge(
  maf_dt,
  pcgr_vaf,
  by = "Match_key",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

maf_vaf[, VAF_match_status := fifelse(
  is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction),
  "unmatched_or_missing_VAF",
  "matched"
)]

maf_vaf[, VAF_filter_status := fifelse(
  is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction),
  "excluded_missing_VAF",
  fifelse(
    VAF_TUMOR_fraction >= MIN_VAF,
    "retained_VAF_ge_0.05",
    "excluded_VAF_lt_0.05"
  )
)]

fwrite(
  maf_vaf[
    ,
    .(
      Hugo_Symbol,
      Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
      Variant_Classification,
      Chromosome,
      Start_Position,
      Reference_Allele,
      Tumor_Seq_Allele2,
      Match_key,
      VAF_TUMOR_fraction,
      VAF_match_status,
      VAF_filter_status
    )
  ],
  match_audit_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = "NA"
)

cat("Tier 1 MAF variant rows:", nrow(maf_vaf), "\n")
cat(
  "Variant rows with matched PCGR VAF:",
  sum(!is.na(maf_vaf$VAF_TUMOR_fraction)),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Variant rows without matched PCGR VAF:",
  sum(is.na(maf_vaf$VAF_TUMOR_fraction)),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Variant rows retained at VAF >= 0.05:",
  sum(
    !is.na(maf_vaf$VAF_TUMOR_fraction) &
      maf_vaf$VAF_TUMOR_fraction >= MIN_VAF
  ),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Variant rows excluded at VAF < 0.05:",
  sum(
    !is.na(maf_vaf$VAF_TUMOR_fraction) &
      maf_vaf$VAF_TUMOR_fraction < MIN_VAF
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Define and retain nonsilent variants
# -------------------------------

nonsilent_classes <- c(
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Splice_Region",
  "Translation_Start_Site"
)

cancer_maf <- maf_vaf[
  Hugo_Symbol_clean %in% cancer_genes &
    Variant_Classification %in% nonsilent_classes &
    !is.na(Hugo_Symbol_clean) &
    Hugo_Symbol_clean != "" &
    !is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction) &
    VAF_TUMOR_fraction >= MIN_VAF
]

message("Total MAF rows: ", nrow(maf_vaf))
message(
  "OncoKB cancer-gene nonsilent rows with VAF >= 3%: ",
  nrow(cancer_maf)
)
message("Applied tumor VAF threshold: VAF_TUMOR >= ", MIN_VAF)
message(
  "Unique retained OncoKB genes: ",
  uniqueN(cancer_maf$Hugo_Symbol_clean)
)
message(
  "Unique retained mutated samples: ",
  uniqueN(cancer_maf$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
)

if (!nrow(cancer_maf)) {
  stop(
    "No OncoKB cancer-gene nonsilent variants remained after ",
    "requiring matched PCGR VAF_TUMOR >= 0.05."
  )
}

filtered_maf_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  paste0(
    "Tier1_common_OncoKB_nonsilent_VAFge5pct_",
    run_date,
    ".maf"
  )
)

fwrite(
  cancer_maf[
    ,
    setdiff(
      names(cancer_maf),
      c(
        "Hugo_Symbol_clean",
        "Sample_key",
        "Variant_key",
        "Match_key",
        "PCGR_rows"
      )
    ),
    with = FALSE
  ],
  filtered_maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = ""
)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
# Rank genes by sample-level mutation frequency
# -------------------------------

# Preserve the original denominator.
total_samples <- uniqueN(maf_dt$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

gene_summary <- cancer_maf[
  ,
  .(
    Mutated_Samples = uniqueN(Tumor_Sample_Barcode),
    Variant_Count = .N,
    Variant_Classification = paste(
      sort(unique(Variant_Classification)),
      collapse = ";"
    ),
    # One added VAF column:
    # median across matched nonsilent Tier 1 variant records in this gene.
    Median_VAF_Percent = if (all(is.na(VAF_TUMOR_fraction))) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      round(100 * median(VAF_TUMOR_fraction, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    }
  ),
  by = .(Hugo_Symbol = Hugo_Symbol_clean)
]

gene_summary[
  ,
  Frequency_Percent := round(
    (Mutated_Samples / total_samples) * 100,
    2
  )
]

setcolorder(
  gene_summary,
  c(
    "Hugo_Symbol",
    "Mutated_Samples",
    "Frequency_Percent",
    "Variant_Count",
    "Median_VAF_Percent",
    "Variant_Classification"
  )
)

setorder(
  gene_summary,
  -Mutated_Samples,
  -Variant_Count,
  Hugo_Symbol
)

fwrite(
  gene_summary,
  summary_file,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  na = "NA"
)

message("Gene-frequency table with PCGR VAF saved:")
message(summary_file)

head(gene_summary, 20)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------
```
```{r}
# Barplot: top 100 frequently mutated OncoKB genes
# -------------------------------

plot_dt <- copy(top100)
plot_dt[, Hugo_Symbol := factor(
  Hugo_Symbol,
  levels = rev(Hugo_Symbol)
)]

p <- ggplot(
  plot_dt,
  aes(x = Hugo_Symbol, y = Mutated_Samples)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, fill = "#5B5B5B") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(
        Mutated_Samples,
        " / ",
        total_samples,
        " (",
        Frequency_Percent,
        "%)"
      )
    ),
    hjust = -0.05,
    size = 3
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 100 Frequently Mutated OncoKB Cancer Genes",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Tier 1 common nonsilent variants with matched PCGR ",
      "VAF_TUMOR ≥3%; n = ",
      total_samples,
      " samples"
    ),
    x = "Cancer gene",
    y = "Number of mutated samples"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )

pdf_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  paste0(
    "Tier1_common_OncoKB_nonsilent_VAFge5pct_top100_",
    run_date,
    ".pdf"
  )
)

png_file <- file.path(
  out_dir,
  paste0(
    "Tier1_common_OncoKB_nonsilent_VAFge5pct_top100_",
    run_date,
    ".png"
  )
)

ggsave(
  filename = pdf_file,
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 12,
  units = "in"
)

ggsave(
  filename = png_file,
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 12,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```
